facts.value: The International Office for Economics is the central point of contact for all students in the department with questions about international topics. It provides advice to students on organizing a study abroad and supports guests from foreign partner universities during their studies in Frankfurt.

Here, international students receive assistance from a Frankfurt buddy to help them acclimate at Goethe University and in Frankfurt. Experienced students provide support with orientation on campus, in studies, and in Frankfurt. The goal is to ease the start into Frankfurt's student life for international students and to offer all participants a chance to meet interesting new people from various countries.
The Equality Council of the Department of Economics offers an English course for administrative staff during the lecture period. Interested participants can inquire via email.
